documents.name: Rozhledna Zlatý Chlum
documents.summary: Zlatý Chlum is a 26-metre stone lookout above Jeseník, Czechia, reached by an uphill walk and offering mountain views into Poland.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Zlatý Chlum above Jeseník gives an uphill walk a rewarding finish, with wide mountain and cross-border views when the tower is open and visibility is good.

booking.note: No reservation required.

duration.note: Approximate round-trip from central Jeseník using the signed 3.7–4.1 km one-way approaches; shorter access variants exist.

coreExperience.note: Self-guided walk/viewpoint.

mobility.note: About 439 m ascent from Jeseník plus tower stairs.

walking-kit.label: Use normal walking footwear and carry water
walking-kit.note: This is a sustained uphill approach.

weather-check.label: Confirm tower opening and visibility
weather-check.note: The operator closes in poor weather.

bad-weather.condition: Rain, fog or otherwise unfavourable weather can close the tower.
bad-weather.note: Check current opening before committing to the climb.

current.note: The tower was confirmed operating in August 2026; opening depends on favourable weather.
